subject: employee_copy_motivation
statement: New employees currently keep calling HR (Muster AG) to ask what they entered in the onboarding questionnaire.

anchors.quote: New employees keep calling us to ask what they entered

subject: employee_copy_email
statement: At the end of the questionnaire, when submitting, the employee should be able to send themselves an email with a copy of their form data.

anchors.quote: at the end of the questionnaire, when they submit, the employee should be able to send themselves an email with a copy of their form data

subject: employee_copy_email
statement: Sending the copy of the form data by email is optional for the employee; not everyone wants it.

anchors.quote: It is optional, not everyone wants it.

subject: copy_email_address
statement: If the employee wants a copy, they type in the email address the copy should be sent to.

anchors.quote: They just type in the email address the copy should go to.

subject: copy_email_address
statement: The copy email address is only needed when the employee chooses to receive a copy (asked only then, not required otherwise).

anchors.quote: It is optional, not everyone wants it.
They just type in the email address the copy should go to.

subject: employee_copy_content
statement: The emailed copy must show the answers exactly as they were submitted, nothing more.

anchors.quote: The copy should show the answers exactly as they were submitted, nothing more.

subject: employee_copy_content
statement: The emailed copy must not contain derived values or any other information beyond the submitted answers.

subject: scope_unchanged
statement: Apart from the email copy feature, everything else stays as discussed in the earlier HR meeting.
